title: GivenWhenThenTesterBase test file
description: Structural contract for the harness-level parts of a test file (given/sequence, steps, retry, meta), enforced by GivenWhenThenTesterBase before a file is run - see the 'validateTestFileFormat' meta flag to opt a file out. The domain payload carried by 'given'/'when'/'then' is subclass-specific - an object for ControllerIT's HTTP request/response shape, but e.g. a plain array of Mongo commands for 'given' in the mongodb module's own harness - so it is intentionally left completely unconstrained here, not even required to be a JSON object. Note: this dialect (com.zuunr.json.schema) has no prefixItems/tuple-items/not, so positional invariants noted in 'description' fields below (given must be sequence[0]; when must be steps[0] and appear only once) are enforced by the harness at runtime, not by this schema. The array was called 'tests' in an earlier version - that name is no longer accepted at all (a file still using it is rejected at runtime with a rename hint, not silently reinterpreted).

sequence.description: sequence[0] must be a givenItem (runtime-enforced, not schema-enforced here). Every later element is either a testGroup (preferred, required if 'retry' is needed) or a legacy flat when/then element grouped by array adjacency.

fileMeta.description: File-level defaults, applied to every test in this file unless overridden per-item.

variables.description: Initial {{name}} -> value substitution variables, available from the first 'when' onward.

defaultRetry.description: Fallback source for any field a group's own 'retry' object omits (per-field, not all-or-nothing). Only consulted for groups that declare 'retry' at all.

validateTestFileFormat.description: Set to false to skip validating this file against given-when-then-test-file.schema.json before running it - an escape hatch for a file that intentionally doesn't conform (e.g. a fixture proving the harness rejects a malformed shape at runtime, where the schema would otherwise reject it first for an unrelated reason and mask the behavior actually being tested).

givenItem.description: Must be sequence[0] (runtime-enforced). Sets up state before any 'when' runs.

testGroup.description: One 'when' plus its 'then' assertions, explicit and order-guaranteed by array position. Prefer this over the legacy flat form for every new group, and it is the only form 'retry' may appear on.

retry.description: Optional. Absent = run 'when' exactly once; an unmatched 'then' fails immediately. Present = re-run 'when' on the configured schedule until every 'then' matches, or until 'timeoutMillis' or 'maxAttempts' - whichever is hit FIRST - stops the loop; the in-flight attempt is still validated for real at that point.

steps.description: Must contain exactly one 'when', as steps[0] (runtime-enforced - see the top-level note on this dialect's limits), followed by one or more 'then's.

whenStep.description: Must be steps[0]. The request/action to (re-)execute; re-issued verbatim on every retry attempt.

thenStep.description: One expected-result assertion, checked against the SAME result as every other thenStep in this 'steps' array.

docExample.description: Whether this group's request/result should be recorded as an OpenAPI example (ControllerIT-specific).

setVariables.description: Maps {{name}} -> a JSON Pointer into the result.

validationStrategy.description: There is no 'JSON_SCHEMA' strategy - a JSON-Schema-based assertion, whether for one field or for the whole result, is expressed under ALLOWING_EXTRA_PROPERTIES via a '$schema' key at the relevant path in 'then' (at the very top of 'then' for 'validate the whole result').

retry.description: Polling/backoff config for one testGroup. The first 'when' call always happens immediately, with no initial delay. All fields are optional and independently fall back to 'meta.defaultRetry', then to a hardcoded harness default.

intervalMillis.description: Wait time before each subsequent attempt. A single number applies the same wait before every retry. An array is an explicit backoff schedule: intervalMillis[0] is the wait before attempt 2, intervalMillis[1] before attempt 3, and so on; once exhausted, its LAST value is reused until the loop stops.

timeoutMillis.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole group, starting at the first 'when' attempt.

maxAttempts.description: Independent safety cap on the number of 'when' calls, regardless of timeoutMillis. Whichever of timeoutMillis/maxAttempts is reached FIRST stops the loop immediately; which one tripped is reported in the log/failure output.

legacyWhenItem.description: Legacy flat form, kept for backward compatibility. 'retry' is not valid here - a 'retry' key found on this shape is a configuration error, not a silent no-op.

legacyThenItem.description: Legacy flat form: one assertion belonging to the nearest preceding legacyWhenItem.
